home_title.en: Markdown to HTML Parser with JSON AST and Mermaid | NanoMD
home_title.zh: Markdown 解析與 Mermaid 渲染｜NanoMD

en.home: NanoMD by Pardn Chiu is a TypeScript Markdown parser that turns Markdown into sanitized HTML and a JSON AST, with on-demand Mermaid, KaTeX and Chart.js.
en.getting-started: Install NanoMD from npm or jsDelivr, render Markdown to HTML in the browser or Node.js, and enable optional renderers.
en.v1-deprecated: What v2 removed from NanoMD v1, how to keep using 1.11.6, the migration path from MDEditor and MDViewer, and v1 vs v2 benchmarks.
en.vs-marked: Markdown to HTML with NanoMD and marked: one document rendered side by side, syntax and sanitizing differences, and parse speed in Chrome and your browser.
en.architecture: How NanoMD splits block parsing, inline parsing, post-processing, HTML output and runtime rendering into separate layers.
en.parsing-pipeline: The order NanoMD checks block types line by line, how inline masking protects links and math, and how footnotes and reference links resolve.
en.ast: Every block and inline node type that Parse() returns, with fields and the Markdown that produces it.
en.syntax-blocks: Headings, paragraphs and blank lines, blockquotes with GitHub alerts, horizontal rules and raw HTML lines in NanoMD.
en.syntax-inline: Bold, italic, strikethrough, highlight, subscript, superscript, escapes, code spans and inline math in NanoMD.
en.syntax-code: Fenced code blocks with backticks or tildes, nested fences, and Mermaid, math and Chart.js blocks with code-block fallback.
en.syntax-links-media: Inline, reference and relative links, bare URLs, images with size, videos, and YouTube or Vimeo embeds in NanoMD.
en.syntax-lists-tables: Unordered, ordered, nested and task lists with tab width control, and GFM tables with column alignment.
en.syntax-footnotes: Footnote references and definitions, numbering by first reference, multi-line definitions and unresolved references.
en.html-output: How AST.html() turns the tree into HTML, which classes it emits, and how it differs from the JSON AST.
en.runtime-dependencies: Load Mermaid, KaTeX, Chart.js and code-prettify on demand with Init(), render them with Refresh(), and handle fallbacks.
en.file-links: Turn local file paths into clickable links that call your own endpoint through the fileEndpoint option.
en.hashtag-links: Turn #tag in Markdown into links to your own tag pages through the hashtagEndpoint option, with Unicode and full-width tags.
en.theming: The nanomd container class, auto-loaded parser.css, dark mode attributes and the CSS variables you can override.
en.security: How NanoMD escapes text and attributes and sanitizes raw HTML, links and URLs in its HTML output.
en.parser-api: Every export of MDParser: Parse, AST.html, Init, Refresh, OnCopyClick, ParseLines and the option types.
en.chrome-extension: NanoMD is a Markdown viewer for Chrome: open local .md files with a live Markdown preview, offline Mermaid and KaTeX, Cmd/Ctrl+S save and file URL access.
en.chrome-extension-privacy: Privacy policy of the NanoMD Chrome extension: it renders local Markdown files and collects, stores or transmits no user data.

zh.home: NanoMD：邱敬幃開發的 Markdown 解析器，將 Markdown 轉成安全 HTML 與 JSON AST，按需渲染 Mermaid、KaTeX。
zh.getting-started: 從 npm 或 jsDelivr 安裝 NanoMD，在瀏覽器或 Node.js 把 Markdown 轉成 HTML，並啟用選用的渲染器。
zh.v1-deprecated: NanoMD v2 移除的 v1 功能、如何繼續使用 1.11.6、從 MDEditor 與 MDViewer 遷移的方式，以及 v1／v2 效能比較。
zh.vs-marked: NanoMD 與 marked 並排渲染同一份 Markdown：語法支援、HTML 消毒，以及在 headless Chrome 與你的瀏覽器中量測的解析速度。
zh.architecture: NanoMD 如何把區塊解析、行內解析、後處理、HTML 輸出與執行期渲染分成獨立的層。
zh.parsing-pipeline: NanoMD 逐行判斷區塊的順序、行內遮罩如何保護連結與數學式，以及註腳與參照連結如何解析。
zh.ast: Parse() 回傳的每種區塊與行內節點型別、欄位，以及產生它的 Markdown 語法。
zh.syntax-blocks: NanoMD 的標題、段落與空行、含 GitHub 提示框的引言、水平線與 raw HTML 行。
zh.syntax-inline: NanoMD 的粗體、斜體、刪除線、標記、上下標、跳脫字元、行內程式碼與行內數學式。
zh.syntax-code: 以反引號或波浪號圍起的程式碼區塊、巢狀圍欄，以及會退回程式碼區塊的 Mermaid、數學式與 Chart.js。
zh.syntax-links-media: NanoMD 的行內、參照式與相對路徑連結、裸網址、可指定尺寸的圖片、影片與 YouTube／Vimeo 內嵌。
zh.syntax-lists-tables: 無序、有序、巢狀與任務清單及 tab 寬度設定，以及可對齊欄位的 GFM 表格。
zh.syntax-footnotes: 註腳引用與定義、依首次引用編號、多行定義與未定義引用的處理。
zh.html-output: AST.html() 如何把節點樹輸出成 HTML、會產生哪些 class，以及與 JSON AST 的差別。
zh.runtime-dependencies: 以 Init() 按需載入 Mermaid、KaTeX、Chart.js、code-prettify，以 Refresh() 渲染並處理退回。
zh.file-links: 透過 fileEndpoint 選項，把本機檔案路徑變成會呼叫自訂端點的可點擊連結。
zh.hashtag-links: 透過 hashtagEndpoint 選項，把 Markdown 裡的 #tag 變成連到自訂標籤頁的連結，支援各語系與全形 ＃。
zh.theming: nanomd 容器 class、自動載入的 parser.css、深色模式屬性，以及可覆寫的 CSS 變數。
zh.security: NanoMD 如何在 HTML 輸出中跳脫文字與屬性，並清洗 raw HTML、連結與網址。
zh.parser-api: MDParser 的所有匯出：Parse、AST.html、Init、Refresh、OnCopyClick、ParseLines 與選項型別。
zh.chrome-extension: NanoMD Chrome 擴充功能：在 Chrome 開啟本機 Markdown 檔並即時預覽，離線渲染 Mermaid 與 KaTeX，Cmd/Ctrl+S 存檔，附允許存取檔案網址步驟。
zh.chrome-extension-privacy: NanoMD Chrome 擴充功能的隱私權政策：只在本機渲染 Markdown 檔案，不蒐集、儲存或傳送任何使用者資料。
